🎉 Welcome to Steal a Vehicle! 🎉
Snag the sweetest rides, outsmart your rivals, and build the ultimate garage empire on Roblox!

🔑 How to Play

🚗 Buy vehicles – every new ride boosts your passive cash.

🕵️‍♂️ Sneak into rival bases and steal their rarest vehicles.

🔥 Rebirth for massive multipliers and a fresh head-start.

👊 Troll friends with gear, gadgets, and good-old slaps!

🚘 304 exclusive models to collect. (UPDATE! 57 NEW VEHICLES including POLICE and MILITARY, plus the new EXCLUSIVE Blackout!)
